# Project governance

Sparkable Digital Solutions (OPC) Private Limited maintains Sparkfeed.

Maintainers set the roadmap, review contributions, manage releases, and protect the project's security and license. They can decline a change that conflicts with product direction, adds unsafe maintenance cost, weakens workspace isolation, or lacks redistribution rights.

Community members can report defects, suggest changes, improve documentation, and submit signed-off contributions. Acceptance does not grant a maintainer role.

Maintainers make decisions in the public issue or pull-request record when the subject is suitable for public discussion. Security reports, customer matters, credentials, infrastructure state, and commercial operations remain private.

Sparkfeed uses `AGPL-3.0-only` and Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off. It does not require a contributor license agreement.
